title: Secret space program friend's father's 'simulacrum' joke

tellings.quote: in encounters Diana also interviews a friend who's was allegedly part of one of the secret American space programs something like the one Tyler from American Cosmic was in

plain: In her book Encounters, Diana Pasulka, a scholar of religion who writes about UFO belief, interviews a friend who was said to be part of one of the secret American space programs, much like a man called Tyler in her earlier book American Cosmic. The story is about a joke the friend's father made about a "simulacrum," though Michels, who tells it himself from Pasulka's book, gives no more detail. He brings it up as a sign that people tied to hidden space programs talk to her openly.
